description: This source file implements Wi-Fi management frame handling functions, including processing association, authentication, and various vendor-specific frames. It registers callbacks for frame transmission and reception events to external components.

methods.description: Handles vendor-specific public action frames, particularly DPP frames, invoking the registered callback.

methods.description: Main callback that processes received management frames and delegates to specific handlers based on frame type.
